verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum web framework. A framework could plausibly ship data-retention or deletion utilities, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers retention policies, data deletion, or user control over stored data. The security items (escaping, CSRF protection, headers) and the page-caching items are adjacent features, not retention controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
